ATTACHED FORM NO. 4 — Certificate of Certification as an Educational Donation Career Experience Institution
[Enforcement Rule of the Career Education Act]

Certificate No. __________

CERTIFICATE OF CERTIFICATION AS AN EDUCATIONAL DONATION CAREER EXPERIENCE INSTITUTION

Certification number: __________________
Name of institution (organization): __________________
Representative: __________________ (Date of birth: __________________)
Address/location: __________________ (Telephone: __________________)

This is to certify that the above institution operates an exemplary educational donation career experience system, having established an excellent framework for educational donation career experience and provided students with diverse opportunities for experiencing occupations, thereby contributing to the happiness of the people and to economic and social development, pursuant to Article 19 of the Career Education Act and Article 9 of its Enforcement Decree.

Year: ____  Month: ____  Day: ____
Minister of Education (official seal)

Paper size: 210 mm × 297 mm; white paper, 150 g/m².
